svg.title: Hip pain sorted by where the patient points: anterior or groin pain inside the joint (hip osteoarthritis, labral tear), lateral pain (greater trochanter bursitis and greater trochanteric pain syndrome) and posterior buttock pain (piriformis syndrome), each with its presentation, exam, investigations and treatment in order, plus the socks question that separates lateral hip osteoarthritis from greater trochanteric pain syndrome
